full.description: This image is a photomicrograph of thyroid tissue showing features of chronic inflammation. There is an extensive lymphocytic infiltrate along with Hurthle cells and atrophic thyroid follicles containing colloid. These findings are characteristic of Hashimoto's thyroiditis, an autoimmune condition affecting the thyroid gland.

blind.description: This is a micrograph of thyroid tissue from the endocrine system. The image shows Hürthle cells accompanied by a dense lymphocytic infiltrate, with little to no recognizable normal thyroid tissue remaining. These histological features are characteristic of Hashimoto's thyroiditis, an autoimmune condition affecting the thyroid gland.

random.description: This image is a micrograph of thyroid tissue showing classic histological features of Hashimoto's thyroiditis. The microscopic field displays widespread destruction of thyroid follicles alongside extensive lymphocytic infiltration and germinal center formation. The remaining follicular epithelial cells often exhibit Hürthle cell changes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm. The dense lymphoid infiltrate and follicular atrophy are characteristic of autoimmune thyroiditis.
